name: Pyridoxine hydrochloride
description: Pyridoxine hydrochloride (CAS 58-56-0 ), commonly sourced under the name vitamin B6 hydrochloride, is the stable salt form of vitamin B6 used across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and cosmetic manufacturing. It functions as a bioavailable B-vitamin source in finished products requiring precise, measurable dosing of B6 activity. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it is formulated into tablets, capsules, and injectable solutions. These formulations target B-vitamin deficiency indications. Nutraceutical producers incorporate it into multivitamin blends, prenatal supplements, and functional food fortification programs where label-declared B6 content must meet specifications. In cosmetic and personal care formulations, it is used in scalp treatments, anti-hair loss serums, and conditioning products. Here, B6 activity supports scalp and follicle health claims for consumers. Food manufacturers apply it as a nutrient fortifier in breakfast cereals, infant formula, and meal replacement products. Pyridoxine hydrochloride is supplied as a white crystalline powder for industrial use. It is available in USP , BP , Ph. Eur. , and food-grade specifications to meet the compliance requirements of pharmaceutical, dietary supplement, and food applications. Bulk quantities are standard for industrial buyers, with smaller quantities available for R&D and quality control purposes.
